title: Clients with KYC on hold (MCX, by e-mail)
purpose: MCX's monthly list of the firm's clients whose KYC is on hold at the KRA: no fresh trades and no square-off on MCX until the KRA marks the KYC compliant (trading resumes T+1); open positions are monitored. None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code.
linked: Matched with the clients on Compliance → KYC trading gate: each client on it is held back on the front ends until the KRA verifies the KYC and a later list no longer has the client.
source: MCX/S&I/522/2026 paras 4-5 (monthly series; earlier MCX/S&I/464/2026). The columns are not published: read by header names.
